graders.name: under-length
graders.why: The message stays at or under 50 prose words, the Slack ceiling.

graders.name: no-headings
graders.why: A Slack message has no Markdown headings.

graders.name: no-ai-tells
graders.pattern: (?i)—|\b(robust|seamless|powerful|crucial|pivotal|delves?|leverages?|streamlines?|journey|landscape)\b|worth noting|here['’]s the thing|at its core|(?:it|this|that)['’]s not (?:just |only )?[^,;.]{1,40}[,;] (?:it|this|that)['’]s|not only [^.;]{1,60}but also
graders.why: No em dashes, inflated vocabulary, or tell phrases.

judge.name: reads_as_slack
judge.description: The message reads as a short Slack post a teammate would write. Answer yes only if it states every supplied fact accurately, puts the change of time first, and has no memo structure: no headings, no greeting or sign-off, and no section labels.
